pages.text: Meet Velociraptor! Its name means 'swift thief.' This little dinosaur lived about 75 million years ago. That is a very, very long time before people were here.
extras: Velociraptor is often called 'raptor' for short.

images.alt: A feathered Velociraptor mongoliensis standing alert

pages.text: Velociraptor was small -- about the size of a turkey! It stood only as tall as your knee. Its long tail helped it balance when it ran fast on two legs.
extras: It weighed about as much as a medium dog.
Half its body length was tail!

images.alt: Velociraptor shown next to a human to compare sizes

pages.text: Surprise! Velociraptor had feathers! Scientists found special bumps on its arm bones that show where feathers attached. But it could not fly. Its arms were too short.
extras: Feathers may have kept it warm.

images.alt: Side view of a feathered Velociraptor in running pose

pages.text: Look at those claws! Each foot had a big curved claw shaped like a sickle. Velociraptor kept this special claw lifted off the ground. It only used it to grab prey.
extras: The sickle claw was over 6 centimeters long!
Each hand had three clawed fingers.

images.alt: Comparison of curved sickle claws from different raptor dinosaurs

pages.text: Velociraptor lived in a hot, sandy place that is now Mongolia and China. It was dry like a desert, with sand dunes and small streams. Other dinosaurs lived there too.

images.alt: The red Flaming Cliffs in Mongolia's Gobi Desert where Velociraptor fossils were found

pages.text: Velociraptor was a hunter. It ate meat and chased smaller animals. It was smart and fast. One famous fossil shows a Velociraptor fighting a Protoceratops. A sandstorm buried them both!
extras: It had about 30 sharp, jagged teeth.
The Fighting Dinosaurs fossil is a national treasure of Mongolia.

images.alt: Illustration of a Velociraptor battling a Protoceratops

pages.text: In 1923, an explorer found the first Velociraptor bones in the Gobi Desert. Since then, scientists have found many more. We learn new things about this dinosaur all the time!

images.alt: A complete mounted Velociraptor skeleton on display

pages.text: You might have seen big, scaly raptors in movies. But real Velociraptors were small and feathery! The movie ones are based on a bigger dinosaur. Now you know the real story!
extras: Real Velociraptor was turkey-sized, not human-sized!

images.alt: A parade of different raptor dinosaurs showing their various sizes
